_README: Adjudicated real-bug benchmark: pre-fix/post-fix ASL pairs mined from public Step Functions repos (eval/mine_realbugs.js), where StepCheck flags a defect on the pre-fix version that the fix removes. Each entry was manually confirmed to be a genuine defect in StepCheck's targeted classes. Run: stepcheck eval-pairs corpus/realbugs --infer.

confirmed_real_bugs.bug: Reads '$.Execution.Input' (single '$' selects a document field 'Execution' that no state produces; the execution input is the context object '$$.Execution.Input'). The '.$' Parameters read fails at run time.
Reads '$.profile.Item' and '$.userId', fields no predecessor produces at those states.
confirmed_real_bugs.fix: Refactors the user-data flow so the reads resolve to produced fields ($.user, $.user.pk.S).

confirmed_real_bugs.bug: A Choice branch guards on '$.profile.subscription.level', a field never produced, so the subscriber branch is unreachable (dead guard) — subscribers were never routed correctly.
confirmed_real_bugs.fix: Corrects the guard to the produced path '$.user.subscription.M.level.S'.

confirmed_real_bugs.bug: A callback task has neither TimeoutSeconds nor HeartbeatSeconds and can wait indefinitely for a token that may never arrive.
